product_metadata.title: Rachael Ray Solid Glaze Ceramics Egg Tray/Holder, 12 Cup, Teal
features: BUILT TO SERVE: Rachael Ray egg tray is crafted from solid glazed ceramic for ultimate kitchen and serving versatility of delicious deviled eggs and baking Rachael's Mini Muffin Cornbread Poppers
GLAZED FINISH: Bold, stylish ceramic serving tray is finished with a satin glaze to preserve the colorful hue and provide easy cleanup
STORE OR SERVE: Egg tray is designed to store eggs in the fridge or serve appetizers during Sunday brunch and family gatherings in style
EASY TO CLEAN: Glazed ceramic egg tray with bold color and contemporary design is dishwasher safe for easy cleanup
OVEN LOVIN': Create delicious appetizers with the oven safe to 500°F egg tray
description: Store and serve with the Rachael Ray Solid Glaze Ceramics Egg Tray. This durable ceramic egg tray holds twelve eggs to store in the fridge or serve yummy deviled eggs for Sunday brunch in style with its bright color and contemporary design. The solid glaze finish helps to preserve the serving trays’ hue while also providing a smooth surface that easily cleans up by hand or in the dishwasher. Appetizers like Mini Muffin Cornbread Poppers, will look absolutely delicious when presented to the hungry crowd on this versatile egg holder. For added conveinence, this tray can is microwave safe to quickly reheat small bites, freezer safe for food storage, and oven safe to 500°F for baking needs.
